hypotheses.O1_payload_write_subspaces_replicate: Every program's rank-16 candidate-write subspace captures at least 60% of the other split's normalized write energy.
hypotheses.O2_output_effect_subspaces_replicate: Every program's rank-16 candidate output-effect subspace captures at least 40% of the other split's normalized logit-delta energy.
hypotheses.O3_shared_read_has_distinct_functions: L7H8 and L9H7 have absolute exact OV cosine below 0.50, rank-16 output-subspace overlap below 0.50, and mean paired output-effect cosine below 0.30.
hypotheses.O4_shared_read_has_same_function: L7H8 and L9H7 have rank-16 output-subspace overlap at least 0.70 and mean paired output-effect cosine at least 0.50.
hypotheses.O5_candidate_payload_is_more_compressibl: For at least two programs, candidate edges have lower normalized-logit effective rank than matched controls in both splits.
hypotheses.O6_boundary_payload_is_stable: L9H8 boundary candidate mean-logit directions have split cosine at least 0.50.
